text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: metering.token_variance.europe — elevated token-count variance + delayed usage batch delivery detected. Severity: SEV2. Runbook: metering/variance-detect.

paging-bot: paging #incidents -> oncall team (ben_oncall) + SRE (dave_sre).

alice_ops: oncall taking this. starting triage.

ben_oncall: seeing a sustained +150-220% token_delta from emitter-eu-*/aggregator-edge for the 06:00-06:20 window. Also batches for partition 14 are delayed ~4m before ledger write. Some customers received overage flags.

ben_oncall: quick sample logs:
```json
{"emitter":"emitter-eu-01","time":"2026-03-20T06:12:03Z","tokens_emitted":12987,"baseline":5230}
{"emitter":"emitter-eu-02","time":"2026-03-20T06:12:05Z","tokens_emitted":14230,"baseline":6100}
```

dave_sre: checking infra — consumer-lag for metering-collector-kafka is 12k on topic usage.events.partition-14, pods collector-{1..3} show restarts on collector-3. kubectl logs show occasional OOMs.

alice_ops: action plan: 1) pause automated overage email dispatch 2) route counting reads to legacy aggregator (stable source) 3) kick off backfill/reconcile job 4) keep customers paused until reconciled.

claire_billing: pause emails now please — some customers already got an overage notification. I need a confirmation and the timestamp when it was paused so we can annotate CCs.

ben_oncall: pausing email dispatch via ops API now. Command: 
```
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/api/flags/pause" -d '{"feature":"overage_emails","reason":"metering_variance_incident"}'
```
Paused at ~1745020005 (UTC). :white_check_mark:

alice_ops: routing counts to legacy aggregator via feature flag flip (billing.use_legacy_aggregator = true). doc note: if legacy path fails, automatic fallback is disabled until we confirm stability.

dave_sre: routing flipped. quick smoke on sample customers returns counts within -5%..+7% of baseline. Starting backfill job now: `/ops/backfill --topic usage.events --from 2026-03-20T06:00:00Z --to now` (I've scoped to partition 14 first).

ben_oncall: backfill job started (job id bf-20260320-01). Recon job will write reconciliation rows to billing-recon. Opening ticket INC-9034 to track credits/reconciliations and customer outreach.

claire_billing: good. I’ll hold customer comms until recon has pasted initial results. Please add quick summary in ticket with exact paused timestamp.

alice_ops: leaving handoff notes for day team in the incident doc: - paused overage emails at 1745020005 - routed reads to legacy aggregator at 1745020030 - backfill job bf-20260320-01 running - collector-3 flagged for OOM, SRE investigating restart policy. Handoff ETA 45m.

dave_sre: creating a short-term mitigation: increase collector replica requests/limits and set restart threshold to avoid cascade restarts. Also adding temporary consumer parallelism bump to drain lag.

ben_oncall: monitoring dashboards: token_delta_percent trending back toward baseline after routing change. Will keep an eye on emitted token stream and ledger write latency.

incident-bot: Incident update: severity lowered to SEV3 (reduced customer-visible impact). Overages flagged: paused. Next automated update in 30m or on notable state change.

claire_billing: ack. Will not send customer emails until INC-9034 has initial reconciliation summary.

alice_ops: handing off to day shift (cc @product, @support). Leave open for postmortem + credits.

ben_oncall: leaving main runbook steps in the ticket. last check: counts normalized on sample 50 customers; ledger write latency back to baseline ~ <200ms for partition 14. Closing slack thread update; will post another note when backfill completes.

incident-bot: Thread closed for now, monitoring continued.
